Source: Lahore High Court Bar Association voter lists 2022–23 for Ahmad Pur Sial, Arifwala, Bhai Pheru, Bhakkar, Bhalwal, Bhowana, Chichawatni, Chiniot, Chunian, Daska, Depalpur, Eimanabad, Faisalabad, Farooqabad, Ferozewala, Ghakkar Mandi, Gojra, Gujar Khan, Gujranwala, Gujrat, Hafizabad, Hujra Shah Muqeem, Jaranwala, Jauharabad, Jhang, Kalurkot, Kamalia, Kamoki, Kasur, Kharian, Khushab, Kundian, Lahore, Lalamusa, Lalian, Malikwal, Mandi Buhauddin, Mankera. Record counts match each list's printed total. Women are counted from the D/o, W/o field and Ms./Mrs./Mst./Miss titles as printed, so a few cards printed with "Mr." and "S/o" may be under-counted. Photos are taken from the printed cards; 3,872 cards were printed without one. One Lahore card (vote no. 22397) was printed without a name. Phone numbers and home addresses are left out of this page.
